name: 4.3 Binomial Distribution

All twelve authored fresh (the bank had zero binomial files): q1-binomial-conditions, q2-binomial-notation, q3-binomial-exact-prob, q4-binomial-at-most, q5-binomial-at-least, q6-binomial-mean-sd, q7-binomial-translate, q8-not-binomial, q9-binomial-compare-outcomes, q10-binomial-greater-than, q11-binomial-or-not, pre-frq-grade-a-binomial-setup. BookSHelf 4.3 is the binomial distribution: three conditions, X~B(n,p), the formula P(X=x)=C(n,x)p^x q^(n-x), mu=np and sigma=sqrt(npq), translating at least/at most/more than/less than, and the without-replacement tell. q10 (P(X>k) via complement) and q11 (mixed binomial-or-not classification) added 2026-08-11 for the section's problem set 4.3.7/4.3.20 and the When-an-Experiment-Is-Not-Binomial section. Pre-FRQ is authored-first (no binomial FRQ to mirror): categories Name the Parameters (2) / State the Probability Question (5) / Compute and Interpret (5), dropped category NAME THE PARAMETERS.
